classification.difficultyReason: Count leap days across nineteen years and interpret the remainder after division by seven.

content.prompt: If 14 January 2006 was a Saturday, what day of the week will 14 January 2025 be?

answer.short:
Tuesday.

The elapsed days leave a remainder of 3 when divided by 7, so advance three weekdays from Saturday.
answer.worked:
The interval contains 19 years. The leap days occur in 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2024, giving 5 extra days.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Elapsed days}&=19\times365+5\\\text{Elapsed days}&=6940\\6940&=7\times991+3\end{align*}$$

The interval is 991 whole weeks and 3 days. Three days after Saturday is Tuesday.
